name: What documents are needed to rent a car in Goa?
answer: You need a valid Driving Licence and government-issued ID such as Aadhar or Passport. Foreign travellers must also carry an International Driving Permit, and we allow WhatsApp verification for faster booking.

name: How does Goa airport car rental work?
answer: We deliver rental cars to Dabolim Airport and Mopa Airport. Simply confirm your flight details and we will have the car ready at arrivals, complete with hotel delivery or airport pickup service.

name: Can I rent an automatic car in Goa?
answer: Yes, Royal Goa Ride offers automatic cars in Goa including Swift, Baleno, i20, Creta, and more for easy urban driving and comfortable airport transfers.

name: What is the security deposit for a Goa car rental?
answer: Security deposits start at ₹3,000 for hatchbacks and may be ₹5,000 for SUVs and ₹10,000 for luxury vehicles. Deposits are refundable after safe return of the car.

name: Is fuel included in the rental price?
answer: Fuel is not included in the rental rate. Cars are delivered with a set fuel level and should be returned at the same level to avoid additional charges.

name: Do you offer hotel delivery across Goa?
answer: Yes, we deliver rentals to hotels, resorts, and guesthouses across North Goa and South Goa as part of our hotel delivery service.

name: What counts as a luxury car rental Goa option?
answer: Our luxury Goa car rental options include premium SUVs and sedans with premium comfort, such as Toyota Fortuner and Audi A3, ideal for special trips or business travel.

name: Can I book a monthly car rental in Goa?
answer: Yes, monthly car rental Goa packages are available for extended stays. Longer rentals offer better value and can include airport delivery, hotel pickup, and flexible return options.

name: Are there any mileage limits for Goa self drive car rental?
answer: Within Goa, most of our rentals include unlimited kilometres. If you plan a longer journey or outstation travel, please confirm mileage terms with our team before booking.

name: What happens if I need to cancel my booking?
answer: Cancellations should be made via WhatsApp or phone. Refunds depend on the notice period and whether the vehicle has already been dispatched or delivered.

name: Can I take a rental car outside Goa?
answer: Standard rentals are for travel within Goa. Outstation travel may be possible with prior approval, additional charges, and extra documentation.

name: How quickly can I get a self drive car in Goa?
answer: We often deliver cars within 30–45 minutes in the Margao area, and same-day bookings are available depending on vehicle availability.

name: Does Royal Goa Ride support WhatsApp booking?
answer: Yes, our fastest booking channel is WhatsApp. Send a message with your dates, pick-up location, and car preference, and we will confirm availability quickly.

name: Which documents do foreign travellers need?
answer: Foreign travellers require a valid passport, International Driving Permit, and a local contact number. All documents can be shared on WhatsApp for faster approval.

name: What are the cancellation terms for a Goa car rental?
answer: Cancellations more than 24 hours before pickup usually get a full refund, while shorter notice may incur a partial or no refund depending on the situation.

name: Is hotel delivery included in the rental price?
answer: Hotel delivery is included for most Goa locations, and we can deliver to hotels in North Goa and South Goa as part of our airport car rental service.

name: What makes automatic cars better for Goa?
answer: Automatic cars are easier for city traffic, frequent stop-and-go routes, and unfamiliar roads. They are ideal for travellers who want comfort without managing a manual gearbox.

name: Do you offer 24/7 roadside support in Goa?
answer: Yes, our customer support is available 24/7 by WhatsApp and phone for any roadside issues, booking questions, or assistance during your rental.

name: What is included in a luxury car rental Goa service?
answer: Luxury car rentals include premium vehicles, airport pickup, hotel delivery, professional support, and smooth driving for special trips or corporate travel.

name: Where can I find your contact and booking details?
answer: You can contact us at +91 99753 56697 or via WhatsApp at wa.me/919975356697 for instant booking help, pricing, and vehicle delivery details.
